title: WebSite JSON-LD contract — Al-Amoudi Furniture
description: Emitted globally from src/app/layout.tsx via WebSiteSchema. After US-10 the schema gains alternateName; potentialAction.SearchAction is FORBIDDEN until /search?q= exists.

alternateName.description: Brand variants used as queries in GSC §4.2. Required after US-10. Reference list: ['مفروشات العمودي', 'العمودي للسجاد', 'Al-Amoudi Furniture']. The canonical 'العمودي للمفروشات' lives in `name` (do not duplicate).

forbidden: potentialAction with @type 'SearchAction' — FORBIDDEN until a real /search?q= endpoint exists. Adding it without an endpoint is a structured-data lie (Constitution III + VII).
